subject: Use intrinsic MSVC functions for counting leading/trailing zeros.
perf_evidence: Commit substitutes MSVC bit-scan intrinsics for portable leading/trailing-zero scans.
change_summary: Changes the MSVC x64 count-leading/trailing-zero implementation used by divider generation.

units.name: raw 32/64-bit count-leading/trailing-zero helpers, unrestricted input
units.evidence: Alive2 gives zero-input counterexamples for ctz32 and ctz64; clz helpers pass.

units.name: bit-count helpers under the library's nonzero-input precondition
units.evidence: All four nonzero/preconditioned clz/ctz helper targets pass bidirectional Alive2 with unroll 65.

units.name: public signed/unsigned 32/64-bit generated division
units.evidence: The two 32-bit API targets time out; the two 64-bit API targets exhaust SMT memory. Neither failure proves an equivalence or counterexample.

notes: The checked configuration models MSVC using Clang's x86_64-pc-windows-msvc target. A solver memout is classified UNKNOWN by METHOD.md even though the older result.json labels it UNSUPPORTED. No public-API counterexample was found.
